Introduction
This 
document details the equipment inspection I1, which should be carried out on an annually 
bases as indicated 
by Y1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear appropriate 
 personal protective safety equipment as safety shoes
 and helmet
Ensure that the 
 earthing switch must be disconnected and properly grounded on both sides using 
 portable grounds.
Ensure that the 
 earthing switch must be disconnected and properly grounded on both sides using 
 portable grounds.
Circuit breaker must be isolated completely and 
 grounded on both sides.
Isolate the DC voltage
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
